_comment: Per-machine operator identity for chalette-dev skills. Lives INSIDE the plugin dir (chalette-dev/config/) so it actually ships with the skills that read it — at the repo root it was outside the plugin payload and never loaded, which meant the synthetic-only rule was prose with nothing behind it. Each person edits this on their own clone; the committed default is the contractor-safe profile.
_comment_workspace_root: null = use the default synthetic fixture (skills/synthetic-workspace-runtime-test/fixtures/clean_workspace). Set a path ONLY if allowed_targets includes 'real'. Previously '~/cr-test-workspace', a directory that never existed on any machine.
_comment_allowed_targets: 'synthetic' = fixtures only. Adding 'real' lets the skills target a live workspace; that is M's profile, not a contractor's.
